fragments.derivationNote: Exact pinned project archive geometry for the RF state beginning 26 Dec 1991, accepted only after distributed inside/outside spatial controls pass. No later claim geometry is back-projected.

baseStates.notes: Month-end RF coverage begins in January 1992. Although the archived vector feature is segmented at 14 Oct 2004, the additional RF–PRC eastern-boundary agreement signed that day did not enter into force until 2 Jun 2005. The pre-settlement Russian legal-border geometry therefore remains valid through May 2005; the successor base begins in June 2005. No later claim geometry is back-projected.
